run_trainer_training: run the MeshRCNN Trainer to train a 3D object detection model on Pix3D dataset
test_trainer_evaluation: test the MeshRCNN model on the Pix3D dataset and return evaluation metrics
build_train_loader: build a training data loader with MeshRCNNMapper for the configured training datasets
build_test_loader: build a test data loader with MeshRCNNMapper for the configured test dataset
setup_configuration: setup the MeshRCNN configuration from a config file and command line arguments
